thread:
maria: Quick sync 35 PR #4213 is green but we need a tiny addition: show what to do when the model returns malformed JSON (parse fallback). Can someone do a tiny JS + Python example? :mag:

aj: Happy to review. Do you want both an SDK-first example (parseWithSchema) and a manual fallback so folks can see both?

maria: Exactly. SDK helper first, then a manual pattern showing `resp.text` fallback and emitting a parse_failure metric. Keep it short.

lucy: I'll write the snippets. For JS use the official client helpers and for Python use the `parse_with_schema` util names that match the SDK. Also add a one-line note about function-calling vs structured-output differences.

devon: Heads up 5 there's a stale link in the PR pointing to `/docs/old-schema-guide`. I'll swap to `/docs/structured-output` and add a redirect note.

maria: thanks. Also add a short "Migration note" for teams that were relying on try/parse patterns, advising them to switch to parseWithSchema to get deterministic errors and telemetry.

aj: I'll add the monitoring pointer to /console/metrics/docs/parse-failures and drop in a screenshot placeholder of the metric graph.

sam: We should also add a docs-e2e test that simulates a model returning "{not:valid}" and asserts the fallback branch runs. I can add a tiny mocked test and hook it to the docs CI job.

lucy: For webhooks, let's be explicit: if you POST model output to a webhook, include `Content-Type: application/json` and check `parse_failure` flag. Treat `text` fallback as human-readable only. I'll add a short paragraph.

devon: I'll push link fixes and the migration diff.

maria: Who's landing the PR? I can shepherd but won't have bandwidth to push commits tonight.

lucy: I can push snippets and the paragraph.

aj: I'll add the metric link + screenshot placeholder.

sam: I'll push the e2e test and a lightweight CI job that runs on docs changes.

docs-bot: Reminder: PR #4213 reviewers assigned: @lucy @devon @aj @sam. CI job docs-e2e-integration queued.

maria: Timeline: aiming to merge tomorrow EOD. If you hit blockers ping me and I'll reassign. :sparkles:
